name: Phenomeno - Mitsurugi Yoishi wa Kowagaranai
original_name: フェノメノ 美鶴木夜石は怖がらない
source:
Visual novel adapted from the youth horror novel written by Hajime Ninomae and illustrated by Yoshitoshi ABe.

Yamada Nagito, a university student living away from home, needing a cheap place to live, finds out about a mysterious “House that grants wishes” on the market for a ridiculously low rent; he snaps up the house and starts living there. A few nights in he starts hearing strange creaking noises. Each and every night he’s assaulted by these torturous noises. The last straw is when he finds the number 7 carved into the wall, as if counting down to something. Yamada having an interest in the occult seeks help from a website he frequently visits: “Ikaigabuchi”, which specialises in occult topics.

[From [url=http://kipchu.wordpress.com/2012/11/10/phenomeno-visual-novel-review/]Kipchu's blog[/url]]
translation:
改編自二前一元執筆、安倍吉俊插畫的青春恐怖小說的視覺小說。

大學生山田仁人在外獨自生活，需要找一個便宜的住處。他發現了一棟租金低得離譜的神秘「許願之屋」，立刻搶下了這棟房子並開始居住。住了幾個晚上後，他開始聽到奇怪的吱嘎聲。每晚都被這些折磨人的噪音侵擾。當他發現牆上刻著數字7時——彷彿在倒數什麼——他忍無可忍了。對神秘學感興趣的山田向他經常造訪的網站「異界淵」尋求幫助，這是一個專門討論神秘學話題的網站。

［來自[url=http://kipchu.wordpress.com/2012/11/10/phenomeno-visual-novel-review/]Kipchu's blog[/url]］
